claims.title: Arithmetic nonsingularity of the original odd receiving frame on 3456 CRT classes
claims.statement: If p is prime, p is congruent to 1 modulo 12, and the three Legendre symbols (-511/p), (1241/p), (-15/p) all equal -1, then every positive integral Erdos--Straus witness at p has nonzero integer receiving numerator N and hence invertible original odd receiving frame. The two exact denominator-divisibility patterns give valuations zero or two. Quadratic reciprocity gives 3456 reduced classes modulo 521220.

claims.title: Sharp paired determinant return in the retained quotient metric
claims.statement: For consecutive native Gram determinant ratios r_L, the exact rank-one identity epsilon_L^2=a_L^2(1-r_{L-1})(1-r_L)/r_L and the aggregate allowance Theta<=epsilon_L imply -log(r_{L-1}r_L)>=2 asinh(Theta/a_L). Summing over L=q,...,2q-1 gives the four-endpoint determinant return D10, with no claim that it is the whole assembled action.

claims.title: Finite holomorphic and positive heat actions with exact remainders
claims.statement: For a finite original-metric operator T(t)=A-tQ with Q^2=0, the holomorphic heat action has an entire outgoing-parameter expansion with the dimension-independent remainder H7. The holomorphic and positive heat actions satisfy the quantitative small-time comparison H13 and the rational stopping certificate H15; they remain distinct functions.

claims.title: Exact signed-cover arithmetic descent and nonsquare twist at q=61
claims.statement: For the genuine witness (13;4,18,468), the normalized quartic modulo 61 has roots 4,13,18,41 and derivative values 18,38,26,30, all nonsquares. The original signed cover has zero F_61-points and eight F_61^2-points; the twist eta^2=2h'(r) has eight F_61-points. The exact base-extension map is eta_2=w eta_1 for w^2=2, Frobenius is four transpositions, and the finite-fibre zeta function is (1-T^2)^(-4).

nonclaims: The sufficient character conditions are not asserted to be necessary.
The five-prime witness census is not the quantified proof.
The finite-fibre zeta function is not identified with the Riemann zeta function.
The determinant and heat tracks do not close RH or the universal Erdos--Straus conjecture.
